summary.text: Chloe Coulson is the Animal Justice Party candidate for Hastings at the 2026 Victorian election. She has spent seven years working with students who have disabilities and complex needs at a special development school, and has studied social work, disability and community development. She also volunteers with local conservation groups and runs a community Spanish group.

occupation.text: Works at a special development school supporting students with disabilities

priorities.text: Protecting native wildlife, including opposing hunting and wildlife culls and restoring habitat
Cutting wildlife deaths on roads with crossings, signage and better data
Stronger, modernised animal welfare and cruelty laws, and more help for wildlife rescuers
More support services for people facing homelessness or family and sexual violence

sources.title: Hastings: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Chloe Coulson for Hastings, Animal Justice Party Victoria

summary.text: Frank Schiefler is the Liberal candidate for Hastings at the 2026 Victorian election, a seat Labor won from the Liberals in 2022. He served as a soldier in the Australian Army and later worked in government. The party also describes him as a community advocate who owns his home in the area.

prior_roles.note: The party says he worked in government without naming the employer or role.

priorities.text: Better local roads and health services

sources.title: Hastings: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Isaac Willoughby is standing for the Greens in Hastings at the 2026 Victorian election. He is a musician who teaches guitar on the Mornington Peninsula. On the party's site he names neglected public transport and the cost of housing as reasons young people leave the area.

priorities.text: Better public transport infrastructure on the Mornington Peninsula
More affordable housing so young people can stay in the area
build a politics that puts people and the planet first

sources.title: Hastings: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Isaac Willoughby, Candidate for Hastings, Australian Greens Victoria

summary.text: Jason Smart is standing as an independent for Hastings at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. At the 2025 federal election a Jason Smart was the Trumpet of Patriots candidate for Flinders and withdrew from the campaign in protest at the party's how-to-vote choices; no source confirms it is the same person. Neither the ABC nor a campaign page had published a biography as at 9 Nov 2026.

previous_candidacies.note: Stood for Trumpet of Patriots. Matched by name only: no source says the 2026 candidate is the Flinders candidate.

sources.title: Candidates for Hastings District, Victorian Electoral Commission
Hastings: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Candidates of the 2025 Australian federal election, Wikipedia

summary.text: Michael Denman is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Hastings at the 2026 Victorian election. He grew up on the Mornington Peninsula and has lived in Crib Point for five years. He has worked in disability services since 2018 and now manages quality and compliance for a registered NDIS provider.

occupation.text: Quality and compliance manager, NDIS registered organisation

priorities.text: well-funded public schools, affordable and quality housing
Public ownership of key resources and infrastructure
Opposing cuts to disability support and defending disabled people's independence

sources.title: Hastings: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Paul Mercurio, a dancer, choreographer and actor best known for the 1992 film Strictly Ballroom, has been the Labor member for Hastings since 2022. Before that he was a Mornington Peninsula Shire councillor for Watson Ward from 2020. He is recontesting Hastings in 2026.

occupation.text: Dancer, choreographer, actor and TV presenter

prior_roles.role: Founder and director, Australian Choreographic Ensemble
Brewer, cook and food business owner
prior_roles.note: No single span of years given.

previous_candidacies.note: Wikipedia gives no party label for this council election; IND is a placeholder, not a sourced fact.

priorities.text: More backing for the performing arts
Arts programs that help young people's physical and mental health
Better public transport to open up jobs and opportunity

summary.text: Peter Angelico is One Nation's candidate for Hastings at the 2026 Victorian election. The child of Italian migrants, he trained as an electrician after leaving school in year 10 and went on to found several manufacturing businesses; he holds the honorary presidency of a manufacturers' group in Melbourne's south-east. A Liberal Party member for about 20 years, he stood for the Libertarian Party at the Nepean by-election in May 2026, which the Liberals won.

prior_roles.note: Wikipedia describes him as a former Liberal member of two decades; no years are given.

sources.title: Hastings: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
